LAREDO, Texas — Brandon Alvarez was arrested early Wednesday, October 21, 2026, at 1:36 a.m., and booked into the Webb County Jail on an alleged third-degree felony charge of possession of a controlled substance in Penalty Group 1, in an amount of 1 gram to under 4 grams, according to Webb County booking records reviewed Thursday.

The Laredo Police Department made the arrest, the records show. Alvarez was booked into the county jail on the single felony charge.

No bond had been set on the charge as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956.

A third-degree felony in Texas is punishable by two to 10 years in prison and a fine of up to $10,000.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Brandon Alvarez is presumed innocent unless proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.

title: BREAKING: Laredo Police Arrest Brandon Alvarez on Third-Degree Felony Drug Charge
